name: Calico-bush
desc: Mountain laurel (Kalmia latifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Kalmia latifolia, the mountain laurel, calico-bush, or spoonwood, is a flowering plant and one of the 10 species in the genus of Kalmia belonging to the heath(er) family Ericaceae.
